channel.description: The FOX News Rundown is your daily news podcast for making sense of the big issues directly impacting your life. Go beyond the headlines every morning and join some of FOX News’ most exceptional journalists—including FOX News Channel reporters Peter Doocy, Aishah Hasnie, Bill Melugin, Alex Hogan, Lucas Tomlinson and Jacqui Heinrich and FOX News Radio reporters Dave Anthony, Jessica Rosenthal, Lisa Brady, and Gurnal Scott - as they tap into the global reporting resources of FOX News and get unparalleled political analysis and exclusive insight from top newsmakers. The Rundown offers a sharp contrast of perspectives you won’t hear anywhere else, and a daily commentary you can't miss, we deliver the full picture of the day's biggest events.

item.title: How Real is the Potential of an Iranian 'Dirty Bomb' Attack?
item.description:
A new threat report describes the possibility of Iran developing plans for a "dirty bomb" attack on Washington, D.C., drawing a warning from President Trump that there would be overwhelming retaliation from the United States. A dirty bomb is a combination of conventional explosives with radioactive or biological material that would spread contamination without producing a nuclear explosion. This has been eyed as a potential attack for years now but experts do say that Iran could make a dirty bomb, but would need someone inside the United States with the level of expertise to handle the materials and carry out an attack
FOX's Eben Brown speaks with EJ Kimball, the director of policy and strategic operations for the U.S. Israel Education Association, who says weakening Iran has put them in a position to think of any kind of retaliatory attack on the United States

item.title: America’s Outage Anxiety & Trust Issues: Martha MacCallum on the ‘Consequential’ Years to Come
item.description:
After a week of widespread tech outages and glitches disrupting airlines, banks, and major software systems, concerns are growing over America’s aging infrastructure and national vulnerabilities. The Story host and executive editor Martha MacCallum joins to discuss what the recent disruptions reveal about systemic weak spots, explain why a growing wave of unaligned voters is upending traditional party politics, and share the inspiring first-person stories of everyday and military heroism featured in her new book, The Book of Valor.
President Trump heads to China for high-stakes meetings with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin. Michael Pillsbury, FOX News contributor and member of the Pentagon’s Defense Policy Board, joins FOX News correspondent Lucas Tomlinson to discuss the possibility of a historic nuclear arms agreement, China’s growing military and AI capabilities, and whether the U.S. can maintain its global standing as Beijing and Moscow strengthen their partnership.
PLUS, commentary by Rich Zeoli, host of The Rich Zeoli Podcast.
PHOTO CREDIT: AP IMAGES

item.title: What's Behind the Craze Over 'Grand Theft Auto VI'?
item.description:
Rockstar Games will officially be launching Grand Theft Auto VI this week, ending a 13-year wait since the previous main installment. Relationships will be tested, marriages and jobs could be lost as players are rabid, signing contracts with their spouses and taking full weeks off from work to play. The blockbuster action-adventure title unlocks on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, returning players to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and the wider state of Leonida.
FOX's Krystin Goodwin speaks with Eammonn Dignam, host of the 'FOX on Games' podcast, who shares the details of the worldwide sensation.

item.title: The Push To Kill The Death Penalty in America
item.description:
California Governor Gavin Newsom has commuted the death sentences of more than 500 inmates, effectively dismantling the state’s death row just days after the midterm elections. Former federal prosecutor and longtime DOJ Capital Review Committee leader Jim Trusty joins the Rundown to examine the legal and political fallout, including the impact on victims’ families and how Newsom’s move is just the latest in the effort to “kill” the death penalty in America.
Just before the Thanksgiving travel rush, a massive tech outage grounded flights nationwide and delayed or canceled 45,000 trips. Former FAA official Mike O’Donnell breaks down what went wrong, explains the challenge of fixing America’s aging air traffic control system, and shares what it will take to prevent another meltdown before the holidays.
PLUS, commentary by David Marcus, columnist for FOX News Digital.

item.title: Questions Swirl Around NVIDIA as President Trump Heads to Asia
item.description:
President Trump has left for Asia but the questions surrounding Nvidia and how its chips ended up in China are sure to follow him as he prepares to meet with Chinese leader Xi Jinping later this week. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick is said to be joining the president on the trip, who is facing pressure from lawmakers and within the administration about why his department didn’t more aggressively clamp down on Nvidia chip exports and why the Singapore-based data center builder Megaspeed wasn’t blacklisted.
FOX's Eben Brown speaks with Max Meizlish, the deputy director of the Center on Economic and Financial Power (CEFP) at the Foundation for Defense of Democracies (FDD), who says the United States has all the tools to apply pressure on China and should not be afraid to use them.

item.title: After a Slew of Tech, Aviation & Espionage Scares, How Safe Is the U.S.?
item.description:
Following a week marked by a reported Chinese espionage plot targeting Nvidia’s CEO, a massive Microsoft outage, and a rare nationwide FAA ground stop, former National Security Council senior director Michael Allen joins the Rundown to discuss concerns about America’s vulnerabilities. Allen discusses China’s use of “honeypot” tactics to target U.S. tech leaders, outdated government infrastructure and growing cyber threats. Plus, he weighs in on potential Iranian retaliation against American officials and the security challenges surrounding President Trump’s upcoming overseas travel.
Strength, hope, and faith are front and center in a new book, titled Graceful Warrior: The True Story of a Son, Father, and a Family Who Carried Each Other Through. Author, award-winning actor and advocate Gary Sinise joins the Rundown to reflect on his son Mac’s five-and-a-half year battle with chordoma, a rare and incurable form of cancer. Sinise shares what it was like serving as the primary caregiver and how decades of working with wounded veterans and military families through the Gary Sinise Foundation helped prepare him to lead his own family through unimaginable hardship.
PLUS, commentary by Jason Chaffetz, FOX News contributor and the host of the Jason In The House podcast on FOX News Radio.
